selected_script.angle: Real-life shower clog pain followed by quick, damage-free silicone drain protection
selected_script.hook: Watching water pool up in a clogged shower drain is the absolute worst.

video_001_part_01.description: 0-3s: Show dirty water pooling up over a clogged bathroom shower drain. 3-6s: Wipe the area around the drain dry and place the grey dome-shaped silicone hair catcher directly over the drain opening. 6-10s: Press down firmly on the corner suction cups to anchor it to the smooth tile surface while water begins running smoothly.

video_001_part_02.description: 0-4s: Cut to the grey silicone hair catcher installed over a bathtub drain with running water flowing freely through the perforated holes. 4-8s: Hand easily lifts caught hair strands off the perforated silicone dome. 8-10s: Light English text overlay: 'Keep your drains clear the simple way.' with a neutral close-up of the clean installed product.

Water starts running smoothly. Keep the exact product identity, matte grey color, perforated dome grid, and embossed logo intact. Do not include a CTA. Fast-paced, realistic.
